en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small coastal settlement at the foot of dark hills. A few large neoclassical-style buildings stand near the shoreline, with scattered smaller houses further back. The sea occupies the foreground. There is printed Greek text at the bottom and extensive handwritten Greek script across the lower and upper parts of the image. A round postal cancellation mark is faintly visible, and a watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appears on the right side.
